races.name: Irish European Breeders Fund Median Sires Series Maiden
races.verdict:
KINDACAN disappointed when down the field at Dundalk 4 weeks ago, yet her debut third over C&D was a promising effort and she's afforded another chance back on turf. Champion Basma stepped up plenty on his first start when second himself in a C&D event latest and is a danger, as is Tavernise.

  1. KINDACAN (IRE)
  2. CHAMPION BASMA (IRE)
  3. TAVERNISE (IRE)

races.name: DNG Nationwide Handicap
races.verdict:
Successful at Navan on his penultimate start, MOLTOPHINO subsequently shaped very well when third over 5f here 3 weeks ago. The return to this trip will hold no fears and he could well be ready to strike again. Keke, last year's winner Unique Journey and Amiata head up the dangers, with Dark Ace another to consider in a highly-competitive handicap.

  1. MOLTOPHINO (IRE)
  2. KEKE
  3. UNIQUE JOURNEY (IRE)

races.name: Irish European Breeders Fund Median Sires Series Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict:
LUNAR EMPRESS improved a little on her previous exploits whilst leaving the distinct impression she's ready for the step up to this trip when second in a Galway maiden 37 days ago and she can confirm as much and get off the mark at the fifth attempt. Woodstream is an appealing newcomer from the Joseph O'Brien yard and commands a look, as does his stablemate Belicoso. Ocean Phoenix and The Captains Day are others who make each-way appeal.

  1. LUNAR EMPRESS (IRE)
  2. WOODSTREAM (IRE)
  3. BELICOSO (IRE)

races.name: DNG Excellence Handicap
races.verdict:
PRIVATE PEACEFUL was well beaten last time but had previously shaped with encouragement in a Listowel maiden that has worked out quite well, and he should have more to offer now handicapping; Navajo Point arrives on the back of a second Gowran success and looks the main danger despite a further 8 lb rise, while Thru and Thru is on a good mark if building on a pair of recent in-frame efforts. Khormor Syd and Lady Arwen are also respected.

  1. PRIVATE PEACEFUL (IRE)
  2. NAVAJO POINT (IRE)
  3. THRU AND THRU (IRE)

races.name: DNG People & Property Maiden
races.verdict:
ALMAZANN has found only one too good on 4 of his 5 starts but bumped into a useful prospect at this track last time and can finally go one better back up in trip. Nemorino is progressive and could prove the main danger if taking another step forward, while Jessica Harrington's Pierre Grosse and Possum are respected.

  1. ALMAZANN (IRE)
  2. NEMORINO (IRE)
  3. PIERRE GROSSE

races.name: Isuzu Ireland Handicap
races.verdict:
Unexposed 3-y-o PRIORSTOWN is in good hands, and he gets the vote ahead of Nicky Larson and Grann's Boy, in what looks an ultra-competitive handicap. Glittering Gem, Alfalfa, Gallo Dell Cielo and Flagstone Lady also appeal.

  1. PRIORSTOWN (IRE)
  2. NICKY LARSON (FR)
  3. GRANN'S BOY (IRE)

races.name: October Racing With 1xBet.ie Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
CUBAN GREY has twice won over C&D and, with both the drop in grade and return to this venue sure to suit, he looks worth siding with. Jordan Breeze has been out of form lately but is well treated on the pick of his efforts and is a big player if bouncing back, while Steel Magnolia and Harry’s Hill head the rest in an open sprint handicap.

  1. CUBAN GREY
  2. JORDAN BREEZE (IRE)
  3. STEEL MAGNOLIA (IRE)

races.name: Feel The Rush With 1xBet.ie Handicap
races.verdict:
This is wide open. SHE'S ON THE BALL hasn't looked back since fitted with a tongue strap and is fancied to quickly resume winning ways following an excellent Listowel second when set plenty to do. Last year's victor Loingseoir heads the list of dangers, while in-form duo La La Lucrative and Givehertilxmas seem sure to be in the mix again.

  1. SHE'S ON THE BALL (IRE)
  2. LOINGSEOIR (IRE)
  3. LA LA LUCRATIVE (IRE)

races.name: Betting.Bet Free Racing Tips Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CROOKED PATH is yet another to improve under the handling of James Owen, and he makes plenty of appeal with sights lowered. The form of Moab's latest handicap hurdle third was well advertised at Chepstow on Saturday, and he's the main danger, while Goodwin could have a say if in the mood.

  1. CROOKED PATH (IRE)
  2. MOAB (IRE)
  3. GOODWIN (IRE)

races.name: Betting.Bet New Betting Sites Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DOUBLE POWERFUL ran a cracker in an ultra-competitive handicap hurdle at the Galway Festival when last seen in August and is worth siding with back chasing in a much easier race. Glen To Glen has posted 2 good efforts over fences since joining Nick Scholfield, including a win, and may provide the chief threat if over his exertions over hurdles at Chepstow on Saturday.

  1. DOUBLE POWERFUL (IRE)
  2. GLEN TO GLEN (IRE)
  3. ALL THE GLORY

races.name: Betting.Bet Play Champion Tipster Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The vote goes to expensive point recruit FEROCIMO, who appeals as the type to make a winning start under Rules. Nightflyer's Uttoxeter win is working out well, but he'll need to concede 7 lb to the selection, while Living In Luxury completes the shortlist for another in-form stable.

  1. FEROCIMO (IRE)
  2. NIGHTFLYER (GER)
  3. LIVING IN LUXURY (IRE)

races.name: Betting.Bet Free Bets Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Fourth in a Grade 2 Aintree bumper that is working out well, EMERALD QUEST should be capable of making a winning start over hurdles. Dan Skelton's Katios Queen stands out as the danger.

  1. EMERALD QUEST (IRE)
  2. KATIOS QUEEN (IRE)
  3. ROXY RUSSET

races.name: tigerbet.co.uk Download Our App Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The Joe Tizzard stable found form again over the weekend so it might be worth chancing I SHUT THAT D'OR to make a successful return after a breathing operation. The thriving Holy Legend rates an obvious threat, while Diplomatic Ash has a good record here.

  1. I SHUT THAT D'OR (FR)
  2. HOLY LEGEND
  3. DIPLOMATIC ASH (IRE)

races.name: tigerbet.co.uk Extra Place Races Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
CHIEF SUNDAY looks a likely bounce-back candidate for a yard among the winners, and he may well capitalise on a much-reduced mark. Uncle Remus, Lord of The Glance and Diamond Days all look credible dangers.

  1. CHIEF SUNDAY (FR)
  2. UNCLE REMUS
  3. LORD OF THE GLANCE

races.name: tigerbet.co.uk Lucky Odds Boost Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BALLYMOREEN made the frame twice from her 3 starts over hurdles earlier in the year and, having previously shown fair form in Irish bumpers, she remains with potential as she makes her handicap debut. She gets the vote ahead of Painted Wolf, who was successful at Fakenham when last seen, with That Is Blue also considered.

  1. BALLYMOREEN (IRE)
  2. PAINTED WOLF (IRE)
  3. THAT IS BLUE (IRE)

races.name: Join Racing TV Now Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
AR AIS ARIS made an encouraging start to his career in what is usually quite an informative bumper here in the spring and should have excellent claims if building on that promise now sent hurdling over a longer trip. Eastern Fire is another serious contender with the step up in distance in his favour, while Petersham Place merits respect having joined a top stable after winning his sole outing in Irish points.

  1. AR AIS ARIS (IRE)
  2. EASTERN FIRE (IRE)
  3. PETERSHAM PLACE (IRE)

races.name: Download The Free Racing TV App Now Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KABRAL DU MATHAN showed high-class form over hurdles for Dan Skelton last season and should prove hard to beat now starting out over fences. Both Hold The Serve (second choice) and Dream Shadow progressed well over hurdles last season and can fight it out for minor honours on their respective chasing debuts.

  1. KABRAL DU MATHAN (FR)
  2. HOLD THE SERVE (IRE)
  3. DREAM SHADOW (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Profits Returned To Racing Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A good-quality course maiden. OLD HABITS will ideally be suited by further in due course, especially being by Malinas, but his bumper form reads well and he's fancied to strike at the first time of asking over hurdles on that basis. Get Out Of My Way is another respected hurdling newcomer having also done some good work in bumpers, while similar comments apply to Kershaw, who's changed hands since his win at Kilbeggan in April.

  1. OLD HABITS (IRE)
  2. GET OUT OF MY WAY (IRE)
  3. KERSHAW (IRE)

races.name: Follow racingtv On Instagram Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
None of these can be ruled out but I WISH YOU can race off the same mark as when a very good Ayr third in the spring and gets the vote with his yard going well of late. Major Fortune also ended last term in fine form and rates a big threat though, while Chasingouttheblues and Golden Point are others to consider in this competitive handicap.

  1. I WISH YOU (FR)
  2. MAJOR FORTUNE (IRE)
  3. CHASINGOUTTHEBLUES (IRE)

races.name: Every Irish Race Live On RacingTV Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MAGNOLIA is going through a good spell and with race fitness on her side, she narrowly shades the vote over interesting handicap debutant Tap Tap Shamie.

  1. MAGNOLIA (FR)
  2. TAP TAP SHAMIE (IRE)
  3. LINALENE (FR)

races.name: RacingTV, Home Of Live Racing Handicap Chase (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but it could pay to side with HOMBRE DE GUERRA to capitalise on a lenient-looking mark on his return with his yard back among the winners of late. Recent Sedgefield scorer Tanking Along could emerge as the main danger, although chasing debutant Minella Marathon and in-form Lermoos Legend can also play a prominent role.

  1. HOMBRE DE GUERRA (IRE)
  2. TANKING ALONG (IRE)
  3. MINELLA MARATHON

races.name: RacingTV, Home Of Live Racing Handicap Chase (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
It might pay to side with one of the chasing debutants here, with KADO SACREE, a dual winner over hurdles in the spring, making most appeal. Follow Charlie has been in good form over the smaller obstacles and can pose the biggest threat over Rock Dj.

  1. KADO SACREE (FR)
  2. FOLLOW CHARLIE (IRE)
  3. ROCK DJ (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Just the 4 runners but some top stables are represented. VELVET OUTLAW held every chance when falling at the last on his sole outing in Irish points and, having since joined a yard with an excellent record in this sphere, is of major interest. A positive market move for Still Game or Saint De Gemix would need taking seriously, however.

  1. VELVET OUTLAW (IRE)
  2. STILL GAME (IRE)
  3. SAINT DE GEMIX (FR)

races.name: Racing Value At bet365 Handicap
races.verdict:
BIG BARD wasn't able to build on the promise of his previous effort when beaten favourite at Kempton last time, but he's worth another chance from what is a handy mark back at this venue. He gets the vote ahead of Valadero, who had excuses on his latest outing, with Stock Market completing the shortlist.

  1. BIG BARD
  2. VALADERO (IRE)
  3. STOCK MARKET

races.name: Each Way Extra At bet365 EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MY BOO BOO was much improved on his third start when runner-up at Ripon, pulling clear of the rest, and he could be ready to get off the mark this time round. Chapel Down made a promising debut despite his big odds and is feared most, ahead of Passerine who is entitled to step forward from her recent outing.

  1. MY BOO BOO
  2. CHAPEL DOWN
  3. PASSERINE (IRE)

races.name: bet365 EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
REECE'S CALL improved from his debut effort when runner-up at Ffos Las last month and he can do better still as he goes up in trip. He is taken to open his account, though Quai Louis is much respected given the promise he showed on his first start, while Top Cote is another to consider.

  1. REECE'S CALL (IRE)
  2. QUAI LOUIS (IRE)
  3. TOP COTE (IRE)

races.name: Bet Boost At bet365 Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Preference is for SHIFRA, who has had a light campaign and now connections have learnt how best to ride her, Pat Phelan's filly can make it 3 wins from her last 4 starts. This return to 1¼m looks a good move for Celtic Spirit, so he could be the one to provide most resistance, with Cosmic Girl rounding off the shortlist for in-form handler Andrew Balding.

  1. SHIFRA (IRE)
  2. CELTIC SPIRIT
  3. COSMIC GIRL

races.name: Bet Boost At bet365 Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Provided he's able to put a lesser effort behind, FIZZY BEAR gets the tentative vote to get off the mark with the step up to 1¼m likely to prove beneficial. Rogers Dream is a mare in form, so she can give the selection most to think about, with Celebrating Ethel and stable-switcher Delusional taken to fight out minor honours.

  1. FIZZY BEAR (IRE)
  2. ROGERS DREAM
  3. CELEBRATING ETHEL (IRE)

races.name: bet365 Handicap
races.verdict:
With some green shoots from the Dennis Coakley yard in recent weeks, it could be worth chancing CONNIE MOON in a wide-open handicap. The likely strong pace will suit C&D winners Darvel and South Kensington, with Daisy Roots also considered given her course record. Unexposed 3-y-os Yachtsman and Inspectre are potentially interesting if staying the longer trip.

  1. CONNIE MOON (IRE)
  2. DARVEL (IRE)
  3. SOUTH KENSINGTON (IRE)

races.name: Position Payout At bet365 Handicap
races.verdict:
BERNING HOT goes well at this track and might prove the answer to a contest where few arrive with compelling claims. Tom Marquand's mount Nutcracker has a much more solid record than the majority of these and is next on the list ahead of Blue Collar Lad. The returning Dakota Power is one to keep an eye on in the betting.

  1. BERNING HOT (IRE)
  2. NUTCRACKER
  3. BLUE COLLAR LAD

races.name: Best Odds Guaranteed At bet365 Handicap
races.verdict:
Perhaps this is the day when HARRY MOLE finally gets his head in front. Honour Your Dreams took a step back in the right direction when runner-up at Wolverhampton recently and heads the dangers along with Bated Breeze.

  1. HARRY MOLE
  2. HONOUR YOUR DREAMS (FR)
  3. BATED BREEZE (IRE)

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
JOUD was unlucky not to make a successful switch to handicaps at Wolverhampton last month and is bred to appreciate this slightly longer trip, so makes most appeal. Oxford Circus isn't long with the James Owen yard and may pose the biggest threat ahead of Pride Eye.

  1. JOUD
  2. OXFORD CIRCUS (IRE)
  3. PRIDE EYE

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
MAGIC TRIP finished to really good effect when third over C&D earlier this month and Andrew Balding's gelding is fancied to record a first handicap success over Island Bear and Nursia.

  1. MAGIC TRIP
  2. ISLAND BEAR (IRE)
  3. NURSIA

races.name: Get The Inside Track With raceday-ready.com EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
GROVE STREET sets a fairly useful standard to aim at so, provided he takes to all-weather, Brian Meehan's colt could be a tough nut to crack returned to calmer waters. He gets the vote over Heno, who showed promise amidst greenness when third in a Leicester maiden last month and is entitled to improve. King Ida and Forged Ahead both look newcomers to note and market support for either may well prove significant.

  1. GROVE STREET
  2. HENO
  3. KING IDA

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
YES WALIIM shaped much better than the bare result at Wolverhampton 17 days ago, denied a clear run before keeping on well, and is fancied to go one better. Maury rates a big threat if able to get into a good rhythm on the front end, while Tuesday's Wolverhampton scorer Midnight's Dream needs respecting also.

  1. YES WALIIM (IRE)
  2. MAURY (IRE)
  3. MIDNIGHT'S DREAM (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
DISTILLATE shaped as if back in form when third at Laytown last month and, though her next 2 outings weren't so good, she's been found a weak contest to make the trip over from Ireland worthwhile. She is selected ahead of Based, who has been hampered by slow starts and traffic trouble since winning in June, and could take a hand, while Mickey Mongoose returns to a track he goes well at.

  1. DISTILLATE
  2. BASED (IRE)
  3. MICKEY MONGOOSE

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BIRKETT BANK gave the odds-on favourite most to do on debut at Wolverhampton last month and is excused her next outing so could be worth chancing for her in-form yard. Lovely Dark Angel ran below the form of her qualifying runs in nursery company at Leicester last time but could bounce back returned to all-weather, while Leucothea has bags of experience and bounced back to form with cheekpieces fitted at Epsom last time.

  1. BIRKETT BANK
  2. LOVELY DARK ANGEL (IRE)
  3. LEUCOTHEA (IRE)

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap
races.verdict:
NEW IMAGE has an incredible course record and a 3 lb rise may not be enough to stop his resurgence for this yard so he's taken to prove too good for several interesting 3-y-os, including the improving Return of the Gods and dual course winner Town Queen.

  1. NEW IMAGE
  2. RETURN OF THE GODS (IRE)
  3. TOWN QUEEN (IRE)

races.name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Nursery
races.verdict:
An open-looking nursery on paper but the eye is drawn to MRS BLUE, who is far less exposed than the rest and Ollie Sangster's filly looks to have been allotted a lenient opening mark. C'est Lui got back on track when fifth at Wolverhampton recently, so he could emerge as the main danger with Sean Levey taking over in the plate, with Chianti and Naval Cop taken to fight out minor honours.

  1. MRS BLUE (FR)
  2. C'EST LUI (IRE)
  3. CHIANTI

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks more winnable than any of JODHPUR BLUE's previous outings on all-weather and he is fancied to make a winning return to a synthetic surface. Norflondonforever is also respected after a good recent effort over C&D so is also respected, with Super Hit completing the 1-2-3.

  1. JODHPUR BLUE (FR)
  2. NORFLONDONFOREVER (IRE)
  3. SUPER HIT (FR)
